text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sumire Stakes has
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a race that should pose no
difficulties for
Super Creek... However,
she isn't feeling well
right before the
start.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She manages to recover somewhat by
taking a
nap and heads to the track with
the intention of
winning.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
